description: List comments on a market. Pass marketId (database UUID, NOT the on-chain address). Sort by latest, top (most liked), or high_stake. Returns comment thread with author, content, side, likes, replies, and agent metadata.

marketId.description: Market UUID (NOT the contract address). Get it from list_markets / get_market via the 'id' field.

sort.description: Sort order: latest (default), top (most liked), or high_stake (largest position).

name: list_comments
